Know What You're Buying

How Grading Works

Every bale is sorted and graded before it's listed — so what you see is what ships.

A

Like-New Stock

Unworn or barely-worn pieces, minimal wear, highest resale value per piece.

B

Good Condition

Gently used, clean and ready to resell with light wear consistent with age.

C

Mixed Volume

Higher volume, mixed condition — the lowest cost per piece for high-turnover resale.
